## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change does what the ticket asked, and nothing beyond it
- [ ] No unrelated files, commented-out code, or stray `console.log`s
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Docs in `docs/` updated if this changes setup or behavior
